items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: Yeah, I played with you a few jobs. Yeah.

ctx.x: Robichaud, Robichaud and then McCullin and all them played with Robichaud. Well, one time they had the brass band all together with this James Williams. And it had been so, you know, they passed off but I could picture all of them. They're all dead and gone now. He was a violin player, Robichaud. You know, you couldn't remember him. But there was a Robichaud I think that played with your dad and also played with you, eh? Robichaud, the piano player. Yeah. Well, he's still living it. Yeah, he's still living it.…
Yeah, I played with you a few jobs. Yeah.
But he was an aged man, you know.
